own.notes: For integer quantity q in 1..1000, select the segment with the largest from <= q, evaluate constant + linear*q + quadratic*q*q, and round to nonnegative integer GBP pence. The ranges are 1–143, 144–507, and 508–1000. Adjacent observations pin down both transitions: q=143 returned 145022 and q=144 returned 145362; q=507 returned 460083 and q=508 returned 373370. The upper range is consistent with a 19% discount on 20514 + 867*q. Its inferred intercept is 16616.34; the additional 0.000001 pence only stabilizes upward half-penny rounding and does not change this model's rounded predictions anywhere in the domain. Validation: all 96 distinct observed own quantities matched exactly, including 56 fresh quantities queried after model selection. Exact, within-1%, and within-5% success rates on those validation queries were all 100%. Confidence is high, but 904 quantities remain unobserved: these results do not prove that no narrow exceptions or additional transitions exist.

other.notes: Use the same global-quantity polynomial evaluation and integer-pence rounding convention. This model was independently reconstructed from successful other-context exports, not copied from own. The advertised negative control was confirmed: other-context create returned 403, while convenience export exposed exact prices. The ranges are 1–62, 63–604, and 605–1000. Adjacent observations establish the transitions: q=62 returned 58680 and q=63 returned 59118; q=604 returned 453507 and q=605 returned 354304. The upper range is consistent with a 22% discount on 13191 + 729*q. Its inferred intercept is 10288.98; the additional 0.000001 pence stabilizes upward half-penny rounding without changing this model's rounded predictions anywhere in 1..1000. All 95 distinct observed other quantities matched exactly, including 56 fresh validation quantities. Exact, within-1%, and within-5% validation success rates were all 100%. Confidence is high, but 905 quantities remain unobserved, so unseen accuracy is inferred rather than exhaustively verified.
